faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NMEDT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NMEDT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 1 Director (Projects), 1 Joint Director (Monitoring & Coordination), 1 Senior Geologist / Senior Geophysicist, 1 Director (Finance and Accounts), 1 Assistant Director (Finance and Accounts), 1 Accountant and 1 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NMEDT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-data proforma (Annexure-I) attached to the circular) and send it to Director & HoD, National Mineral Exploration and Development Trust (NMEDT), 9th Floor, Jeevan Prakash Building, 25, K.G. Marg, New Delhi - 110001, by speed post or e-mail, through proper channel, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level-13 (₹ 123100 - 215900) in the pay matrix for Director (Projects), Level-12 (₹ 78800 - 209200) in the pay matrix for Joint Director (Monitoring & Coordination), Level-11 (₹67700 - 208700) in the pay matrix for Senior Geologist / Senior Geophysicist, Level-13 (₹ 123100 - 215900) in the pay matrix for Director (Finance and Accounts), Level-10 (₹ 56100 - 177500) in the pay matrix for Assistant Director (Finance and Accounts).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving officers of Central/State Government, UTs, autonomous or statutory bodies, PSUs, universities or recognised research institutions holding an analogous post or with the prescribed feeder-grade service. They also need a bachelor's degree, a Bachelor's/Master's in Geosciences/Earth Sciences/Geophysics, B.Com/MBA (Finance), a Commerce/BBA (Finance) degree or any degree, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers of Central/State Government, UTs, autonomous or statutory bodies, PSUs, universities or recognised research institutions. Candidates of Non-Government Organizations are eligible only for Short Term Contract. Exemption from rule of immediate absorption is not required for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the closing date or without the required documents are liable to be rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Information in the CV and supporting documents on essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation including short term contract (ISTC). Period of deputation: 05 years for Director posts, 04 years for Joint Director and Sr. Geologist / Sr. Geophysicist, 03 years for others. Pay, Deputation (Duty) Allowance and tenure regulated by DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010.
